mapper.insert: insert into sys_operation_log ( user_id, user_name, module, business, oper_type, request_uri, request_method, request_param, result, cost_time, status, trace_id, oper_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{userName}, #{module}, #{business}, #{operType}, #{requestUri}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestParam}, #{result}, #{costTime}, #{status}, #{traceId}, now() )
